celt: In old times, a Celt lived by the river.
很久以前，一个凯尔特人住在河边。
Did the Celt paint his body blue?
那个凯尔特人把身体涂成蓝色了吗？
Read this old book about the Celts!
读一读这本关于凯尔特人的旧书吧！
censor: In old times, the censor asked about every family.
很久以前，审查官会挨家挨户做调查。
The censor will not let that word in!
审查官不让那个词出现！
Did the censor take that page out?
审查官把那一页拿掉了吗？
census: The census tells how many people live here.
人口普查告诉我们这里住着多少人。
What did the census ask your family?
人口普查问了你们家什么？
cent: I found one cent on the sidewalk.
我在人行道上捡到一枚一分硬币。
Keep your cents in this little box!
把你的分币放进这个小盒子里吧！
ceramic: The ceramic bowl was painted blue and yellow.
那只陶瓷碗涂上了蓝色和黄色。
Who made this little ceramic cup?
这个小陶瓷杯是谁做的呀？
Paint your ceramic bowl red and white!
把你的陶瓷碗涂成红色和白色吧！
cerebrum: The cerebrum is inside your head.
Does your cerebrum work when you dream?
你做梦的时候大脑也在工作吗？
Use your cerebrum and think hard!
ceremonial: The girls put on their ceremonial clothes.
姑娘们穿上了典礼用的衣服。
Did you hear the ceremonial song at school?
你听到学校里的典礼歌曲了吗？
Watch the ceremonial dance on the stage!
快看舞台上的庆典舞蹈！
ceremony: Our school had a big ceremony today.
我们学校今天举行了一个大典礼。
Did you like the ceremony at school today?
你喜欢今天的学校典礼吗？
Let's go to the ceremony together!
我们一起去参加典礼吧！
certification: The pilot got a certification for flying planes.
那位飞行员拿到了飞行资格证书。
Did you get your swimming certification today?
你今天拿到游泳证书了吗？
Work hard and get a certification too!
好好努力，你也能拿到证书！
certitude: He said with certitude that it would rain.
他非常肯定地说会下雨。
Can you say it with certitude?
你能百分之百肯定地说吗？
I know with certitude that you can do it!
cetacean: A cetacean is a big animal like a whale.
鲸类动物是像鲸鱼一样的大动物。
Which cetacean can jump out of the water?
哪种鲸类能跳出水面呢？
Wow, that little cetacean can swim fast!
哇，那头小鲸类游得真快！
chafed: My new shoes chafed my feet.
What chafed your back on the long walk?
走那么远的路，是什么磨到了你的背？
Oh no, the wet swimsuit chafed her belly!
哎呀，湿泳衣把她的肚子磨红了！
chagrin: To my chagrin, my paper airplane got wet.
让我懊恼的是，我的纸飞机湿了。
Did you see the chagrin in his eyes?
你看到他眼里的懊恼了吗？
Don't let chagrin stop your smile!
别让懊恼挡住你的笑容！
challenge: The long swim was a big challenge.
那次长距离游泳是个大挑战。
Will you take the reading challenge?
Take the hard challenge and never give up!
接下这个难题，永不放弃！
champion: The fox was the long jump champion.
Who is your school's swimming champion?
你们学校的游泳冠军是谁？
Wow, she is the tennis champion!
chant: Our team did a fun chant today.
我们队今天喊了一段有趣的口号。
What chant does your team sing?
你们队喊的是什么口号？
chaos: There was chaos in the lunchroom today!
今天食堂里乱成了一团！
What made the chaos in the classroom?
Too many toys make chaos in your room.
玩具太多，你的房间就会乱糟糟的。
chapel: The old chapel is near the small lake.
那座旧小教堂在小湖旁边。
Is the little chapel open today?
那座小教堂今天开门吗？
Look at the old chapel on the cliff!
快看悬崖上的那座旧小教堂！
charitable: The charitable girl helps her little brother.
这个有爱心的女孩常常帮助她的小弟弟。
Was that a charitable thing to do?
那算是乐于助人的善举吗？
Be charitable and help people every day!
要有爱心，每天都要帮助别人！
charity: We gave our old books to charity.
我们把旧书捐给了慈善机构。
Did your family give food to charity?
你们家给慈善机构捐过食物吗？
Giving to charity can make people smile!
向慈善机构捐助能让人露出笑容！
charm: What is that charm on your backpack?
你书包上挂的那个小饰物是什么呀？
The fairy's charm put the bear to sleep.
仙女的咒语让熊睡着了。
Say the charm and the door will open!
念出咒语，门就会打开啦！
charter: Our charter says we will be good friends.
我们的章程上写着：我们要做好朋友。
Let's make a charter for our new team!
我们为新建的小队制定一份章程吧！
chassis: What a long chassis this truck has!
这辆卡车的底盘真长呀！
The chassis is under the body of the car.
Where is the chassis on the truck?
chatelaine: The chatelaine of the big house welcomed us.
大宅的女主人欢迎了我们。
How the chatelaine loved her big garden!
这位女主人多爱她的大花园呀！
Who was the chatelaine of that old house?
那座老宅子的女主人是谁呢？
cheater: What does a cheater do in a game?
骗子在游戏里会做什么？
Don't be a cheater in our game!
在我们的游戏里可不许作弊哦！
chemotherapy: Chemotherapy helps people who do not feel well.
化疗能帮助身体不舒服的病人。
Does chemotherapy take a long time?
Give hugs to people who get chemotherapy!
给正在化疗的人一个拥抱吧！
chime: His watch chimes at three o'clock.
他的手表在三点钟会报时。
Did you hear the chime of the door?
你听到门铃的叮咚声了吗？
What a nice chime that little truck has!
那辆小卡车的铃声真好听呀！
chisel: The worker used a chisel on the big rock.
工人用凿子凿那块大石头。
Give me that chisel from the tool box!
把工具箱里那把凿子递给我！
What is that chisel on the desk for?
桌上那把凿子是干什么用的？
chiseled: He chiseled a fish out of the big rock.
他从大石头里凿出了一条鱼。
What a fine little horse he chiseled!
他凿出来的小马真漂亮呀！
Did you see the words she chiseled?
你看到她凿刻的字了吗？
chlorophyll: Do yellow leaves have chlorophyll too?
黄叶子里也有叶绿素吗？
Find the chlorophyll in this green leaf!
找一找这片绿叶里的叶绿素！
choreographer: The choreographer made the dance for the big stage.
编舞老师为大舞台编排了这支舞。
Wow, the choreographer can really dance!
哇，这位编舞师跳得真棒！
chorus: The chorus sings on the stage every spring.
合唱团每年春天都在舞台上演唱。
Listen to the frog chorus by the pond!
听听池塘边的青蛙合唱吧！
Do you want to sing in the school chorus?
你想在学校的合唱团里唱歌吗？
chronicle: The old book is a chronicle of our city.
这本旧书是我们城市的编年史。
Read a page of the chronicle to me!
What does the chronicle say about the old bridge?
编年史里是怎么写那座旧桥的？
cinch: The long swim was a cinch for the seal.
对海豹来说，长距离游泳是小菜一碟。
Wow, this easy game is a cinch for you!
哇，这个简单的游戏对你来说轻而易举！
Is drawing a cinch for you now?
你现在画画也是小菜一碟吗？
cipher: The friends made a cipher with numbers and letters.
伙伴们用数字和字母编了一套密码。
Write your cipher in the little book!
把你的密码写进小本子里吧！
circulation: Run and play every day for good circulation!
每天跑步玩耍，让血液循环更好！
Good circulation keeps your body warm.
血液循环好，身体就暖和。
游泳对血液循环有帮助吗？
circumference: The round rug has a circumference of ten feet.
这个圆地毯的周长是十英尺。
Walk the circumference of the garden with me!
跟我一起绕花园一圈走一走吧！
What is the circumference of the round table?
这张圆桌的周长是多少呀？
circumnavigate: The team will circumnavigate the big lake by boat.
队员们将乘船环航这个大湖。
Can a plane circumnavigate the ocean in a day?
飞机能一天内绕海洋一圈吗？
Let's circumnavigate the pond in our little boat!
我们坐小船绕池塘一圈吧！
circumstance: In this circumstance, we should ask for help.
在这种情况下，我们应该寻求帮助。
Under no circumstance should you swim at night!
任何情况下都不许在夜里游泳！
What circumstance made the baby cry?
什么情况让宝宝哭了呢？
cistern: The big cistern gets rain water from the roof.
大蓄水池从屋顶收集雨水。
Is there water in the cistern?
Do not play near the old cistern!
不要在旧蓄水池附近玩耍！
cite: Did you cite the book about whales?
你引用那本关于鲸鱼的书了吗？
You must cite the story in your paper.
你必须在作文里注明这个故事出自哪里。
Cite the book when you write about pandas!
写熊猫的时候要注明参考的书哦！
citizen: Every citizen of the city can use the library.
这座城市的每位市民都可以使用图书馆。
Be a good citizen and keep the park clean!
做个好公民，保持公园干净！
What does a good citizen do?
city-state: In old times, a city could be a city-state.
很久以前，一座城市就能成为一个城邦。
What a big wall the city-state had!
那个城邦的城墙真高大呀！
Was the city-state near the big river?
那个城邦在大河附近吗？
civil: Please be civil to your little sister.
It is civil to say hello and thank you.
问好和道谢是有礼貌的表现。
Was that a civil thing to say?
civility: Use civility when you ask for help.
Her civility made the new girl smile.
她的礼貌让新来的女孩笑了。
Why is civility a good thing?
为什么说礼貌是件好事呢？
civilization: The old civilization had big buildings and long streets.
那个古老的文明有高楼和长街。
Look at the map of that civilization!
What did the people in that civilization eat?
那个文明的人吃些什么呢？
claim: She claims her big dog can dance.
她声称她的大狗会跳舞。
What did he claim about the big fish?
关于那条大鱼，他都说了些什么？
Please claim your red mittens at the desk.
请到桌前认领你的红手套。
clamor: I heard the clamor of many birds outside.
我听到外面许多鸟儿的喧闹声。
What a clamor the geese made by the pond!
池塘边的大鹅吵得可真热闹呀！
Why all the clamor in the classroom?
教室里怎么这么吵吵嚷嚷的？
clan: Our big clan eats together every winter.
我们大家族每年冬天都聚在一起吃饭。
Welcome to the clan, new friend!
欢迎加入我们家族，新朋友！
Is your clan a very big family?
你的家族是个大家庭吗？
clandestine: She had a clandestine look at her presents.
她偷偷地看了一眼自己的礼物。
What a clandestine little mouse you are!
你这只偷偷摸摸的小老鼠呀！
Who made that clandestine hole in the sand?
是谁在沙子里偷偷挖的洞呀？
clarifier: The clarifier cleans all the water for the city.
澄清池能为城市净化所有的水。
Look, the clean water comes out of the clarifier!
看，干净的水从澄清池里流出来啦！
Where do they use the clarifier?
人们在什么地方使用澄清池呢？
clasp: Is the clasp on your bag hard to open?
你书包上的搭扣难打开吗？
The little girl clasped her bear and slept.
小女孩抱着小熊睡着了。
Open the clasp of the little box!
打开小盒子上的搭扣吧！
classic: Is that old song a classic?
那首老歌是经典歌曲吗？
Grandmother loves to read classic stories.
Play that classic game with us!
和我们一起玩那个经典游戏吧！
classical: Grandfather listens to classical music every night.
爷爷每天晚上都听古典音乐。
Who plays that nice classical song?
那首好听的古典曲子是谁弹的呀？
Turn on the classical music, please!
classify: Can you classify these animals by their legs?
你能按腿给这些动物分类吗？
We classify books by title at the library.
我们在图书馆按书名给图书分类。
Classify your toys and put them in the box!
把玩具分类放进箱子里吧！
clever: The clever fox got the big carrot.
聪明的狐狸拿到了大胡萝卜。
Who is the cleverest animal in the story?
故事里最聪明的动物是谁呀？
climate: The climate here is warm and dry.
这里的气候温暖又干燥。
What a cool, wet climate the rainforest has!
雨林的气候又凉爽又湿润呀！
What is the climate like in the jungle?
丛林的气候是什么样的呢？
climax: The climax of the story made me jump!
故事的高潮吓得我跳了起来！
How did you feel at the story's climax?
故事高潮的时候你有什么感觉？
Read to the climax of the story, then stop.
读到故事的高潮就停下来。
cloak: Grandfather has a warm cloak for the cold winter.
爷爷有一件过冬的暖斗篷。
Put on your cloak, little one!
穿上你的斗篷吧，小家伙！
Who is under the big black cloak?
黑色大斗篷下面是谁呀？
clone: The two little cats are clones.
Wow, the little clone looks just like its mother!
哇，这只克隆小家伙长得和妈妈一模一样！
clutch: The baby bird clutched the big leaf.
鸟宝宝紧紧抓住那片大叶子。
Clutch your hat on the big slide!
滑大滑梯时要抓紧你的帽子哦！
What did the little monkey clutch?
小猴子紧紧抓住了什么呀？
coastal: Crabs live on the coastal rocks.
螃蟹住在海岸边的岩石上。
Do you live in a coastal city?
The coastal air is clean and cool!
海边的空气干净又凉爽！
coax: I tried to coax the cat from the bed.
我想哄猫咪从床上下来。
Can you coax the dog out of the box?
你能把小狗从箱子里哄出来吗？
Coax the baby to eat her peas!
哄哄宝宝，让她把豌豆吃下去！
code: The computer uses code to make the game work.
电脑用代码让游戏运行起来。
Write the code, and the robot will dance!
写好代码，机器人就会跳舞啦！
coding: Do you like coding at school?
你喜欢在学校上编程课吗？
Coding is fun and not too hard.
编程很好玩，也没有太难。
Try coding a game with your big brother!
试着和哥哥一起编个小游戏吧！
coffin: In old times, people made coffins from logs.
很久以前，人们用圆木做棺材。
Did they find the coffin under the sand?
他们在沙子下面找到那具棺材了吗？
Look at the old coffin in this book!
快看这本书里的古代棺木！
coincidence: Running into you here was a big coincidence.
在这儿碰到你，真是太巧了。
What a coincidence that our two dogs are friends!
我们两只狗成了朋友，真巧呀！
cold-blooded: A snake is a cold-blooded animal.
The cold-blooded lizard is so slow today!
这只冷血蜥蜴今天动作真慢呀！
collaborate: My friend and I collaborate on art at school.
我和朋友在学校一起合作画画。
Do you like to collaborate with your team?
Let's collaborate on a big painting!
我们一起合作画一幅大画吧！
collaborator: She is my collaborator for the school play.
她是我排演校园剧的合作者。
Who is your collaborator for this big painting?
这幅大画你请谁合作画的呀？
A good collaborator listens and helps you!
好的合作伙伴会倾听并帮助你！
collapse: The old tent will collapse under all that snow!
那顶旧帐篷会被大雪压塌的！
Did the bridge collapse in the big rain?
那座桥是在大雨中塌的吗？
Oh no, our little cookie house collapsed!
哎呀，我们的饼干小屋塌了！
colleague: Mother and her colleague work at the big store.
妈妈和她的同事在大商场上班。
Does your colleague sit near you?
你的同事坐在你旁边吗？
Her colleague is also her good friend!
她的同事也是她的好朋友！
collective: Our collective work cleaned the big park.
我们大家的集体劳动把大公园打扫干净了。
Was making the family lunch collective work?
做全家人的午饭算是集体劳动吗？
Our collective garden looks so nice now!
我们的集体花园现在真漂亮呀！
collision: The two toy cars had a big collision!
两辆玩具车撞了个正着！
Did you see the collision of the toy trains?
你看到玩具火车相撞了吗？
The bikes had a little collision at the park.
自行车在公园里轻轻碰了一下。
colonial: In colonial times, people made bread at home.
在殖民时期，人们在家自己做面包。
What did colonial kids do for fun?
殖民时期的孩子们玩什么呢？
Colonial work was hard but good!
殖民时期的活儿辛苦却有意义！
colonist: The colonists lived near the river.
What food did the colonists eat?
殖民者吃些什么食物呢？
How hard the colonists worked in the fields!
殖民者在田里干得多卖力呀！
colonization: We read about the colonization of a far coast.
我们读到远方海岸被殖民的历史。
When was the colonization of that old city?
那座古城是什么时候被殖民的？
Find the page about colonization in this book!
在这本书里找到讲殖民的那一页！
colonize: They will colonize the far coast by boat.
他们将乘船去殖民那片遥远的海岸。
How did the little seeds colonize the garden?
小种子是怎么在花园里安家落户的？
How fast the bugs colonized the old log!
虫子在旧木头上安家可真快呀！
coma: A coma is a very long sleep.
昏迷是一种很沉很长的昏睡。
Was the long sleep a coma or a nap?
那么长的昏睡是昏迷还是打盹呀？
Read stories to grandfather in his long coma.
在爷爷昏迷时给他读读故事吧。
combat: The two birds had a combat over the worm.
两只鸟为一条虫子打了一架。
Wow, his combat boots are so big!
Did you see the combat of the big beetles?
你看到大甲虫的搏斗了吗？
combatant: In the story, the combatants were big beetles.
在故事里，参战的是大甲虫。
Look at the two little combatants on the leaf!
快看叶子上的两个小搏击手！
commemorate: We commemorate the day with songs and flowers.
我们用歌声和鲜花纪念这一天。
Why do we commemorate this day every spring?
为什么每年春天我们都要纪念这一天？
Let's commemorate the big day with a picnic!
我们用野餐来纪念这个大日子吧！
commence: School will commence at nine o'clock.
commendable: It was commendable to help the new kid.
帮助新同学是值得表扬的行为。
Do you think that was commendable?
你觉得那样做值得称赞吗？
comment: She made a nice comment about my drawing.
她夸了我的画，给了句很好的评价。
What comment did you write on the card?
你在卡片上写了什么评语呀？
Comment on your friend's good work!
评价一下你朋友的好作品吧！
commerce: There was a lot of commerce at the market.
市场上的买卖可真兴隆。
Does the small city have much commerce?
这座小城市的商业多吗？
How much commerce this old street has!
这条老街的生意真红火呀！
commercial: The new commercial made us laugh.
那则新广告把我们逗笑了。
Did you see the commercial about cereal?
你看到那个麦片的广告了吗？
That commercial for cookies looks so yummy!
那则饼干广告看起来真好吃呀！
commiseration: She patted my back in commiseration.
她满怀同情地拍了拍我的背。
Did you feel commiseration for the crying kid?
你同情那个哭泣的孩子吗？
Give your friend a hug of commiseration!
给你朋友一个安慰的拥抱吧！
commission: She got a commission to paint the big wall.
她接到委托去画那面大墙。
What does the city commission do?
市政委员会是做什么的呀？
The art commission loved her painting!
艺术委员会很喜欢她的画！
commitment: A new dog is a big commitment.
养一只新狗可是个大承诺。
Do you have the commitment to read every day?
Good work takes commitment and time!
做好一件事需要投入和时间！
committee: The committee works hard for our school.
委员会为我们的学校辛勤工作。
My mother is on the cookie committee!
我妈妈是饼干委员会的成员！
Who is on the library committee?
图书馆委员会都有谁呀？
commodity: Corn is a big commodity at the market.
玉米是市场上的一种大宗商品。
What commodity does your family buy every day?
你们家每天购买的商品是什么？
Wow, bread is a very old commodity!
哇，面包可是历史悠久的商品呀！
commoner: Most people in the old city were commoners.
旧城里的大多数人都是平民。

那个平民去大市场了吗？
